name: Necromancer: an Animated Bone Wraith unleashes Bonestorm on its own while it fights
contract: Animate: Bone Wraith 805032 summons creature 50309 for 15 s and reads 'While active, it will periodically unleash a Bonestorm, striking up to $801411i nearby enemies ... every $801412t1 sec for $801412d.' Spell.dbc makes 801412 a 5 s self aura triggering Bonestorm 801411 every 0.5 s, proc-triggered by the Bone Wraith passive 800037, which carries no proc flags, no spell_proc row and no interval. Nothing cast 801412 except an explicit Command, so a fighting Bone Wraith only meleed. Owner ruling (2026-11-15): while it has a target, it starts a new Bonestorm whenever the previous one ends. An idle Bone Wraith does not spin; a fighting one spins at least twice within its life.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
CONTROL: an idle Bone Wraith does not spin
DISCRIMINATING: the fighting Bone Wraith unleashes Bonestorm
It spins again once the first 5 s Bonestorm ends
